final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS A FROM signals GROUP BY rfistat), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(A) AS B FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.rfistat AS rfistat, s1.A AS A, s1.A - s2.B AS AB, s2.B AS B FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s1.A > s2.B WHERE s2.B IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(A) AS D FROM s3) SELECT s3.rfistat, s3.A, s3.AB, s3.A - s4.D AS CD FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.D IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s3.rfistat
